## 14. Global brand-system framework

### Brand color scheme

- identity color field: navy foreground on a cream field.
- interaction and status color references: green is reserved for positive state proof.
- product, campaign, and photographic color boundaries: product neutrals do not replace identity colors.

### Typography hierarchy

Observed reference values: one large headline scale, one compact support scale, and a readable body scale.

### Spacing strategy

Spacing strategy uses four repeatable intervals.

### Layout strategy

Layout strategy alternates an asymmetric editorial grid with isolated proof frames.
